subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should reset/delete session transcript archives adopt the Option B local-date-prefix filename contract for configured `agents.defaults.userTimezone` users?
rationale: This changes a persisted archive basename contract that current docs do not define as a timezone surface, so maintainers need to bless the compatibility shape before merge.

options.title: Approve Option B after coverage
options.body: Adopt the local-date prefix while requiring QMD archive-hit support, old-format upgrade coverage, and real reset/delete proof before merge.

options.title: Accept a narrower contract
options.body: Allow reset/delete archive basenames to change now and explicitly defer QMD or memory-hit behavior as follow-up work.

options.title: Pause filename policy
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open and pause this PR until maintainers choose a broader archive filename policy.

recommendation.title: Approve Option B after coverage
recommendation.body: Adopt the local-date prefix while requiring QMD archive-hit support, old-format upgrade coverage, and real reset/delete proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties current archive helper and QMD transcript-hit surfaces to this person, and the decision spans those shared session surfaces.
